full_judgment: 29. PW-2 Md Nawab Khan deposed that the parties are known to him. He deposed that he has land adjacent to the south of the disputed land and he is a Manager of the Co-operative Society, Chandpur and has collected loans and interest. He deposed that the plaintiffs are in possession of the suit land and it is not a fact that the sisters of defendant No. 1 gifted land to him. He deposed that the plaintiffs are in possession of the disputed property and he was about 8/9 years old at the time of CS operation and defendant No. 1 conducted the affairs for recording of their interest.
